Good to know

A few things to know.

The details worth knowing, without the fine print.

There is no minimum term and no escalation clause. Give 30 days notice and the agreement ends.

Quotes are built from a free analysis of what you print today, so you are not paying for capacity you never use.

Delivery, installation, configuration and user training are included. Terms and conditions apply.

An add-on that closes the gap between your service agreement and your insurance, for a fixed monthly amount.

Ask a Seartec technician

Recurring problems can point to something bigger: incorrect setup, missed servicing, or a device that no longer suits the workload. Our technicians find the cause and recommend the right fix.
